dialog.description: Paste your Server-to-Server OAuth app credentials from the Zoom Marketplace. A per-account Meeting SDK app is optional (see below). Apps must live in the same Zoom account.
dialog.editWarning: Leave secret fields blank to keep the existing values.

sdkCredentials.title: Meeting SDK credentials (optional)
sdkCredentials.description: Leave blank to use a platform-provided shared Meeting SDK app. For anonymous learner joins, the Meeting SDK app must belong to this same Zoom account — add your own SDK app here unless your platform has a shared one configured.

webhookToken.label: Webhook Verification Token
webhookToken.placeholder: Copy from Zoom Marketplace → your S2S app → Feature → Event Subscriptions

setDefault.title: Set as default account
setDefault.description: The default is preselected when admins create a new Zoom meeting.
